fusions.name: Dazzling Frill
fusions.desc: Flares a sudden shift of colour that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stuns them for 1 second. Each has a 35% chance to be turned against its allies for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Turncoat Spit
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. Spits venom that deals 9 damage, with a 40% chance to turn the target against its allies for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Colours of the Thicket
fusions.desc: You and your allies are veiled for 6 seconds, enemies notice you 60% later, and you move 15% faster. The veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Feigned Stillness
fusions.desc: Your dodge chance rises by 12% against enemies carrying your afflictions.
